title: Datadog, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Datadog, Inc. completed a redomiciliation from Delaware to Nevada on April 21, 2026, after stockholder approval at a special meeting. The company changed its state of incorporation while maintaining its NASDAQ listing under symbol DDOG. The company states no material changes to business, operations, or contracts resulted from this reorganization.
key_points: Stockholders approved the redomiciliation from Delaware to Nevada on April 21, 2026
The company filed a certificate of conversion with Delaware and articles of conversion and incorporation with Nevada
No change in business, jobs, management, or material contracts resulted from the redomiciliation
Class A and Class B common stock converted 1-for-1 to Nevada Corporation shares; DDOG continues trading on NASDAQ
All outstanding equity awards converted to corresponding Nevada Corporation awards under the same terms
Company adopted new Nevada Charter and Nevada Bylaws as part of the reorganization
